subject: ShinyApp uses my computer as a server?

messages.author: 15f816ef10fb90f4
messages.subject: ShinyApp uses my computer as a server?
parts:
Hello,

I deployed my Shiny App project to web, I am using the "free" option. I realised that people cannot use my app from the link if my computer is not connected to Internet. Is it the same for everybody or did I do something wrong? Can we use a server (not my own computer) in the free option?

Best Regards,

Yesim S.

messages.author: 299a5089d6c6c523
messages.subject: Re: ShinyApp uses my computer as a server?
parts:
Once you deploy your application to shinyapps.io it is available on the Internet.
If your application connects back to your local computer as a data source, then no, the application will not work if your computer is not on the Internet.
